title: Alchemy Arena Definition (opaque pointer)
description: Alchemy stores the Arena DEFINITION only and never provisions infrastructure. Beyond the identity fields below the document is opaque to Alchemy: the battle runtime contract is modelled in the aventiqlab-platform repo (docs/battle-runtime-architecture-v1.md, docs/battle-infra-spec.md) and executed by Arena.

contractVersion.description: Version of the battle runtime contract the embedded spec targets.
